test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Heat Engine) Official Paper (Held On 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following symptom or indicator does NOT show the failure of an oil pump?

options.text: If a hydraulic lifter in a vehicle creates noise
When the engine oil flow slows or stops, the components continue to be lubricated by hot oil that is not permitted to flow
Able to push oil through the system adequately and with low pressure in oil lines
When the engine runs at a normal temperature and oil flow is steady.

solution:
The correct answer is __When the engine runs at a normal temperature and oil flow is steady.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• If a hydraulic lifter in a vehicle creates noise, it may indicate an oil pump failure.
 
• When the engine oil flow slows or stops, components continue to be lubricated by hot oil that is not permitted to flow, suggesting a potential oil pump issue.
 
• A pump unable to push oil adequately and with low pressure in oil lines may indicate failure.
 
• However, when the engine runs at a normal temperature and oil flow is steady, it does NOT indicate oil pump failure.

**Additional Information__**

 
• **Oil Pump Function:**

 
 
• The oil pump is responsible for ensuring adequate lubrication of engine components.
 
• Failure of the oil pump can lead to engine overheating and damage.
 
 
 
• **Symptoms of Oil Pump Failure:**
 
 
• Low oil pressure warning light.
 
• Increased engine noise or knocking sounds.
 
• Elevated engine temperature.
